description: Plans: checkout. WHEN: buy a plan or add-on. Returns an order code (DB-XXXXXX). While checkout is open: send the exact amount on X Money with the order code in the note; the order stays PENDING_PAYMENT until the payment is matched, then your pass activates (30 days, no auto-charge). While checkout is not open yet: the order code saves your spot on the waitlist and nothing is due. Send idempotency_key so a retry never makes a second order. Registered key required. Example: plan_checkout {"sku":"<sku>"}

idempotency_key.description: Client-chosen id. Same key = same order.

key.description: Your ark_ key (or send Authorization: Bearer <key>). Registered keys only.

payment_method.description: When checkout is open: x_money (default) or paypal (house_bot/vip subscription approve URL).

sku.description: house_bot ($4.99 30-day pass), vip ($14.99 30-day pass), credits_100 ($2.99), godmode_1 ($2.99), godmode_3 ($6.99).

name: plan_checkout
title: Plans: start an order
